title: Impact of Anti-Glutamatergic Medications on Survival in Glioma Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study
summary: This study investigates whether certain medications that modulate the glutamatergic neurotransmitter system can improve survival in patients with malignant brain tumors (gliomas). To this end, existing data from approximately 5,000 patients treated at Heidelberg University Hospital will be analyzed. The aim is to determine whether these drugs—originally developed for other medical conditions—may also have a beneficial effect in the context of brain tumors.

interventions.name: All patients treated at the Department of Neurology at Heidelberg University Hospital with a tumor of the central nervous system (CNS), for whom data are available between January 1, 2000, and May 21, 2025, will be included.
